description: Generate a cryptographically secure random password using the secrets module. Supports configurable character sets (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) and optional exclusion of ambiguous characters. Guarantees at least one character from each enabled set.

inputs.description: Length of the generated password. Defaults to 16. Minimum is 4.
inputs.name: length

inputs.description: Include uppercase letters (A-Z). Defaults to True.
inputs.name: uppercase

inputs.description: Include lowercase letters (a-z). Defaults to True.
inputs.name: lowercase

inputs.description: Exclude visually ambiguous characters (0, O, l, 1, I). Defaults to False.
inputs.name: exclude_ambiguous

outputs.description: The length of the generated password.
List of character sets included in the password.
